english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the remains of a destroyed or badly damaged building or site.
Use this when the desolate place is specifically a site of ruins.

examples.english: That old castle is now nothing but a ruin.
examples.traditional: 嗰座古堡而家淨係得返廢墟。
examples.jyutping: go2 zo6 gu2 bou2 ji4 gaa1 zing6 hai6 dak1 faan1 fai3 heoi1

examples.english: After the earthquake, that place was nothing but desolation.
examples.traditional: 地震後，嗰度只剩低一片廢墟。
examples.jyutping: dei6 zan3 hau6 go2 dou6 zi2 zing6 dai1 jat1 pin3 fai3 heoi1
